scope: Original design summaries with pinned task links where available. Methodology-only cards are explicitly labeled; benchmark execution and verifier correctness are not certified by inclusion.

examples.title: Shared editor toolbar and focus
examples.what_it_tests: State ownership when several rich-text editors share one toolbar; focus, selection, disabled state, and cleanup.
examples.how_it_tests: Interaction tests switch active editors, apply toolbar actions, inspect selection and picker state, and remove/recreate editors.
examples.adaptation_guidance: Adapt to the customer's editor or shared controls. Grade user-visible state and cleanup rather than private implementation names.
examples.difficulty_policy: Choose easy, medium, and hard variants based on the customer workflow; upstream difficulty is not a customer difficulty rating.

examples.title: Grid layout sizing and placement

examples.adaptation_guidance: For web interfaces use pinned browser/viewport geometry checks; add responsive integration for the hard tier.
examples.difficulty_policy: Choose easy, medium, and hard variants based on the customer workflow; upstream difficulty is not a customer difficulty rating.

examples.title: Abort asynchronous work during teardown

examples.difficulty_policy: Choose easy, medium, and hard variants based on the customer workflow; upstream difficulty is not a customer difficulty rating.
